node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one Newton reciprocal reduction
node.statement: For the reduced order-one roots x_i, the jth reciprocal coefficient equation is exactly e_j((x_i^star)^m)=e_j(x_i^(-m)). Newton identities therefore construct the first three necessary equations from traces at m,2m,3m, and the H-1 interior equations plus the constant-product equation are equivalent to the full reduced reciprocal identity. No generic mth-power resultant is required.
node.notes: Exact resultant-free reformulation. The first-three trace system is necessary only; parameter elimination and the pointwise Frobenius/cyclotomic/inner tests remain open.
